category_edits.rationale: Untie history and target embeddings, initializing the target table as an exact copy without consuming additional random draws. Both tables retain unit L2 normalization, existing width and zero padding, and train jointly within each category's single GRU model. Separate embedding roles may reduce conflicting gradients. Preserve GRU topology, dot-product scoring, loss, optimizer and routing. The generated predictor dynamically imports the updated model class and restores both tables from its single checkpoint.
